name: PHASE25_CONFIRMATION_PREREGISTRATION
primary_comparisons: VP - C0: Does the progress executive beat the unguided model?
VP - B0: Does the progress executive beat the strongest simple heuristic?
mechanism_comparison: VP - V1: Does Progress add value beyond Q+I2?

promotion_bar.gate_3_success_noninferiority: VP success >= C0 success and VP success >= B0 success
promotion_bar.gate_4_rescue_advantage: VP rescues more than it breaks vs B0 (McNemar p < 0.05 preferred)
promotion_bar.gate_5_no_pathological_defer: VP premature DEFER count <= C0 and <= B0
promotion_bar.gate_6_no_premature_answer: VP premature ANSWER count <= C0 and <= B0
promotion_bar.gate_7_resource_efficiency: VP mean steps <= C0 and VP mean steps <= B0
promotion_bar.note: If VP merely saves 0.2 utility while everyone remains perfect, that is an efficiency optimizer, not a substantially better executive. The target is rescuing tasks when budgets are tight because it avoids wasted actions.

secondary_metrics: McNemar exact test (VP vs C0, VP vs B0, VP vs V1)
prohibitions: No modification to VP, Q, I2, Progress weights/rules after seeing results
No modification to prompts, thresholds, or utility definitions
No modification to confirmation tasks after hash
This is attempted falsification, not another optimization cycle

decision_tree.if_VP_passes_all_gates: Freeze DAPH_PROGRESS_EXECUTIVE_V1 as confirmed. Proceed to cross-model replication.
decision_tree.if_VP_fails_vs_B0: VP has not demonstrated consequential improvement. Keep V1+I2 as the executive. Investigate whether the failure is in Q, Progress, or the interface.
decision_tree.if_VP_passes_but_marginal: If Delta_U(VP-B0) > 0 but CI barely excludes 0, treat as weak evidence. Do not promote without replication.
decision_tree.if_VP_fails_due_to_pathological_defer: Reject Progress. The mechanism is harmful, not helpful. Keep V1+I2.
